The counselor?
Was his name Maruki?

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.speaker: Yusuke

entries.en: You two got talking, then?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For a stranger to connect with[n]Futaba is no easy feat. He must[n]have quite a talent for this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not sure "talent" is the word[n]for it, but yeah, he's cool.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What, you wanna get him to[n]counsel you too?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see no point in having my heart[n]probed by an utter stranger.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Truth, man.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still, I am curious as to how he[n]managed to negate Futaba's[n]usual reticence.

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But he's such a good listener, right?[n]Maybe you ended up talking more[n]than usual.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So it's true! He does have some[n]extraordinary effect!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Surely he must have some greater[n]insight, the better to espy the[n]innermost truths of the heart!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit, this dude has ESP!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "Espy." To see or perceive.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Makoto—is there any way you[n]could arrange for me to meet him?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What? Me? You want to[n]meet him that badly?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please. I feel there is something[n]here I must confirm for myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, I can't make anything[n]happen instantly, but... I'll see[n]what I can do.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My sincerest thanks. I'm looking[n]forward to finally meeting him.
